notes.title: Halloween Cosmic Horror Update is Live!
notes.content:
What's new:

As the witching hour comes to a close, we have one last treat for you! Behold - the Halloween Cosmic Horror Update! Delve deeper into the mysteries of the Café R'lyeh with one fresh new ending for each datable entity. Whether you're ensnared by love or trapped in madness, a chilling new twist awaits. It's a treat that will test the bounds of your heart and sanity!
